response.sql: WITH patient_avg AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb FROM Laboratory WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID), overall AS (SELECT AVG(HGB) AS overall_avg FROM Laboratory WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL), above AS (SELECT p.ID, p.avg_hgb FROM patient_avg p, overall o WHERE p.avg_hgb > o.overall_avg), above_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_hgb) AS mean_of_avgs FROM above) SELECT a.ID, a.avg_hgb AS avg_hgb, a.avg_hgb - o.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall, a.avg_hgb - b.mean_of_avgs AS diff_from_above_mean FROM above a, overall o, above_avg b ORDER BY diff_from_above_mean DESC LIMIT 10;
